text:
deploy-bot: Initiating percent rollout: service=redwood-inference-api, from=release/v2.4.1 to=release/v2.5.0, target=15% global, regions=[us-west-2, ap-south-1], change-window=2026-03-23T02:00Z. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.5.0 :rocket:
karen: starting point-of-contact for this deploy. i'll watch ap-south-1 latency and error spikes. ping me if anything looks off. :mag:
marco: seeing spike in ap-south-1 within 3m: median latency +40ms, p95 from 180 -> 410ms. error rate small but 5xxs increased from 0.1% -> 1.1%.
ops: any stack traces or specific endpoints? 504 vs 5xx?
marco: mostly timeouts at the proxy layer (504). runtime logs show backpressure on local batcher queue. snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T02:03:12Z] host=ap1-gpu-2 svc=batcher level=warn msg="enqueue failed" queue_len=512 max_q=512
[2026-03-23T02:03:14Z] host=ap1-proxy-1 svc=proxy level=warn msg="upstream 504" target=/v1/chat
[2026-03-23T02:03:17Z] host=ap1-gpu-2 svc=runtime level=error msg="rpc timeout to model shard" err="deadline exceeded"
```
ops: batcher saturation could be due to different batching config in v2.5.0 or changed default max_batch_wait. any config diffs?
zhen: v2.5.0 enabled adaptive-batcher=true and increased max_batch_wait_ms from 8 -> 25 for throughput. that might cause longer in-queue waits under bursty ap-south traffic.
rachel: if it's adaptive + longer wait, small bursts could amplify latency. proposal: pause rollout and consider region pinback to v2.4.1 for ap-south-1. we can keep us-west-2 at 15% while we triage.
karen: agree. try to avoid global rollback. can deploy-bot pause the progression?
deploy-bot: Received command: pause_rollout(service=redwood-inference-api, rollout_id=rl_1860024567). Status: PAUSED at 15% global.
marco: quick vote: 1) ap-south pinback to v2.4.1 (isolates), 2) adjust batcher flags on v2.5.0 nodes and re-test, 3) full rollback.
zhen: prefer ap-south pinback + immediate config patch in staging. we should also run a small A/B: patch a subset of v2.5.0 ap nodes with max_batch_wait_ms=10 to verify.
ops: routing supports region-level pin. executing pin command now.
deploy-bot: Executing regional pin: set_route(service=redwood-inference-api, region=ap-south-1, target_release=release/v2.4.1)
ops: Command: `deployctl pin --service redwood-inference-api --region ap-south-1 --release v2.4.1`
ops: Pin applied. Verified routing table: ap-south-1 -> v2.4.1. Monitoring metrics.
marco: ap-south p95 dropping back toward baseline within 2 minutes. 5xxs decreasing. initial signs look good.
karen: keep rollout paused. ops, collect logs from the v2.5.0 ap-south instances and attach to the ticket. zhen, coordinate the staging patch.
zhen: will run A/B in staging with max_batch_wait_ms=10 and adaptive-batcher=true. will post results in ~20m.
rachel: i'll update release notes internal blurb: mention region isolation for ap-south-1 due to batcher backpressure. hold public notes until root cause confirmed.
ops: logs aggregated and ticket BUG-4602 created: https://internal.redwood/bugs/4602. Attached batcher metrics and config diffs.
deploy-bot: Rollout snapshot: service=redwood-inference-api, global=PAUSED at 15%, ap-south-1=PINNED->v2.4.1, us-west-2=15% on v2.5.0, rollout_id=rl_1860024567.
karen: decision: keep paused for 45m while teams triage. if staging patch looks good, consider a controlled re-roll to ap-south with adjusted batcher defaults. jin? (ops)
ops: ack. will alert if any regressions in us-west-2. also scheduling an infra check for network egress jitter in ap region.
marco: monitoring for 30m and will report back.
zhen: starting staging matrix now. will report latency/throughput and error deltas.
rachel: prepping incident blurb for #incidents: short note + link to BUG-4602. will wait to post until we validate.
deploy-bot: Regional pin action completed at 2026-03-23T02:07:45Z. No automatic rollback triggered.
karen: thanks team. I'll run a quick sync in 30m and we can decide next steps (re-roll with conservative batcher settings or ship a 2.5.1 hotfix). closing thread unless new signals appear.
